questions.stem: Two unlabelled bottles stand on a laboratory shelf. One holds hydrochloric acid and the other holds acetic acid, and both are of one-molar concentration. A student must decide which of the two is the stronger acid before starting an experiment. Assertion (1): Because the two acids have the same concentration, the student can expect them to be equally strong. Assertion (2): The two acids produce the same amount of hydrogen ions in solution. Reason: Hydrochloric acid and acetic acid of the same concentration produce different amounts of hydrogen ions in solution, and the acid that gives rise to more hydrogen ions is the stronger one. Choose the correct option. (A) Both statements are true and statement (1) is the reason for statement (2). (B) Both statements are true but statement (1) is not the reason for statement (2). (C) Statement (1) is true but statement (2) is false. (D) Both statements are false.

questions.stem: A fisherman notices that the fish in a river running past his village are fewer each year, and that the trouble is worst after the rains. Assertion (1): Acid rain flowing into the river has made the survival of aquatic life in that river difficult. Assertion (2): Acid rain brings about this change by increasing the strength of the alkali in the river water. Reason: As the pH value increases from 7 to 14, it represents an increase in the strength of alkali. Choose the correct option. (A) Both statements are true and statement (1) is the reason for statement (2). (B) Both statements are true but statement (1) is not the reason for statement (2). (C) Statement (1) is true but statement (2) is false. (D) Both statements are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Statement (1) is true but statement (2) is false.

questions.stem: A student wants to find out whether the soil in a flower pot is acidic. She dips a strip of paper impregnated with universal indicator into a solution of the soil and holds the strip beside a pH scale. Assertion (1): The strip of paper can be used to find the pH of the soil solution. Assertion (2): On this scale pH is measured generally from 0, which means very acidic, to 14, which means very alkaline. Reason: The p in pH stands for 'potenz' in German, meaning power. Choose the correct option. (A) Both statements are true and statement (1) is the reason for statement (2). (B) Both statements are true but statement (1) is not the reason for statement (2). (C) Statement (1) is true but statement (2) is false. (D) Both statements are false.
